title: The espresso machine
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A two-group machine arrives on a flatbed. Gully bought it with the shack money. He knows nothing about coffee.

panels.composition: The boat launch. A flatbed truck. A DELIVERY MAN and GULLY lowering a chrome two-group espresso machine the size of an engine block onto the dock. WOOD and BARNABY watching.

balloons.text: Two-group. Indestructible. Guy in Eugene went under.

image.prompt: two men lowering a huge chrome two-group espresso machine off a flatbed truck onto a wooden dock at a boat launch, a young man and a small dog watching, brush-pen black and white

balloons.text: Do you know anything about coffee.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man asking skeptical questions on a dock

panels.composition: The machine inside the shack, on the counter, between the bait cooler and the register. Absurd. Gleaming. Gully's hand on it.

image.prompt: a gleaming chrome espresso machine sitting on a shack counter between a bait cooler and an old register, a young man's hand resting on it proudly

panels.composition: Gully pulling the first shot. Steam. Wood holding the cup. Tasting. The dog. A long beat.

image.prompt: a young man in a fisherman's apron pulling an espresso shot on a chrome machine in a shack while another young man tastes from a small cup with surprise, a small dog watching

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: The machine comes first; the shop is named next summer. '...That's actually—' 'Yeah.' rhymes with 1997.
